faq.q: Are you available for freelance work?
faq.a: Yes, I take on select freelance projects throughout the year. I'm currently available for new engagements starting Q3 2025. Reach out early to reserve a spot.

faq.q: What types of projects do you work on?
faq.a: I specialise in full-stack web applications, interactive front-end experiences, and design-to-code implementations. I'm comfortable working solo or integrating with an existing team.

faq.q: What does your typical process look like?
faq.a: Every project starts with a discovery call to align on goals and scope. From there I move through design, development, and a structured review phase before handoff or launch.

faq.q: Do you work with international clients?
faq.a: Absolutely. I've collaborated with clients across Europe, North America, and Southeast Asia. I'm flexible with time zones and async-first communication.

faq.q: How do you handle project pricing?
faq.a: Projects are scoped and quoted individually based on complexity, timeline, and deliverables. I offer both fixed-price and retainer arrangements. I'm happy to discuss what fits your budget.

faq.q: Can I see more work than what's on the Projects page?
faq.a: Yes — I have additional case studies and NDA-protected work I can share privately during a call. Just mention it when you reach out.
